app.title: Hyperscale Landscapes
pick.sites.help: These load from data bundled with this site. Nothing is sent to other services.
pick.search.privacy: Searching sends your words to OpenStreetMap's Nominatim service.
pick.upload.help: GeoJSON, KML or KMZ. The file stays on your device.
pick.toolarge: This area is {w} × {h} km. The browser can build up to about 3 × 3 km (9 km²). For larger areas, use the Python tool.
pick.large: Above about 3 km across, buildings become hard to make out at 150–200 mm.
size.exag.note: Hills are drawn {x} times taller than they are, so they show at this scale. Every download says so.
export.3mf.help: Opens in Bambu Studio, OrcaSlicer and PrusaSlicer with colours assigned.
export.lowres: Browser downloads are lower resolution than the Python tool's. For planning hearings or exhibitions, ask someone to run the Python tool.
caption.exag: Height exaggerated ×{x}; buildings at true height
